en.title: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs
en.hook: Learn how answer-verified distillation integrates multi-domain capabilities into a single deployable model.
key_takeaways: Overcomes challenges in integrating domain-specific RL capabilities
Utilizes answer verification for multi-teacher distillation
Builds unified, highly capable single deployment models
